summary: Iteration 61 - Comprehensive testing of guided narration expansion, retreats cleanup, and app-store polish routes. All 21 backend tests passed. All frontend features working correctly. The backend /api/content/expand-script endpoint correctly enforces minimum 7-minute narration with word count aligned to duration (120 words/min). Retreats page shows empty state after cleanup. Terms, Privacy, and Support Center pages all render correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from iteration 61 are working correctly. Backend expand-script endpoint enforces minimum 7-minute narration (840+ words) and scales with duration (120 words/min). GuidedPracticeOverlay fetches expanded script from backend and auto-starts playback. Retreats collection is empty after cleanup (owner can add their own). App-store polish routes (/terms, /privacy, /support) all render correctly with proper content.

guided_practice_overlay.details: GuidedPracticeOverlay fetches expanded script from backend, shows timer, play button, and long-form narration content
